units.source_text: 老夫人派小公子的乳母宰相君向源氏公子传言：

en.t: The elderly lady sent the young lord's nurse, Saisho no Kimi, to deliver a message to Prince Genji:
I had hoped to speak with you in person, my lord,

units.source_text: 只因悲愤之余，心乱如麻，

en.t: but in my grief and resentment my heart has been in utter confusion,

units.source_text: 拟待心情稍定，再图相见。

en.t: so I meant to wait until my feelings had settled a little before seeing you.

units.source_text: 岂料公子在天色未晓之时即将离去，殊觉出人意外。

en.t: I never imagined that you would be leaving before daybreak; it has taken me quite by surprise.

units.source_text: 这可怜的孩子尚在酣眠，能否待他醒来相送？”

en.t: This poor child is still fast asleep; could you wait until he wakes, so that he may see you off?

units.source_text: 源氏公子闻言，泪盈于睫，便吟诗道：

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, tears filled his eyes, and he recited a poem:
